roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.headline: Five healthcare and contact-center analytics workstreams
roles.lead: I partner with Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Support, Data Engineering and leadership to turn ambiguous healthcare and contact-center questions into KPI frameworks, dashboards, deep dives and executive-ready recommendations.
highlights: Build trusted data products across Snowflake and the BI layer: dimensional models, reusable SQL, data-quality and reconciliation checks, refresh monitoring, metric definitions and lineage, with HIPAA-aligned handling of patient data.

Voice of Patient business review: executive appendix reporting across patient-coordinator, billing and live-chat channels, mapping CSAT/NPS and queue-level metrics to Twilio and Heap and validating survey response rates and AI sentiment filters.

AI Disposition dashboard and PC Performance scoreboard: L1/L2/L3 drilldowns for AI-generated call dispositions, and ranking logic for conversion, efficiency and call outcomes that keeps unstable metrics from distorting the overall score.

Communication and SLA analyses: delivery, callback and payment behavior with significance tests (3-day payment rates, Tuesday absorption around 99.8–99.9%), and reconciled Salesforce, Twilio, Calabrio and warehouse outputs for ticket-transfer SLAs.

roles.title: Business Support Specialist
roles.headline: Power BI modernization for commuter and stipend operations
roles.lead: I own the modernization of Power BI reporting for commuter-use and stipend operations.
highlights: Rebuilding the reporting for the 2027 program year: archiving, expiration logic, editable SharePoint-based tracking, fleet-readiness metrics and approval and status visibility.
Refining data models, KPI definitions and exception logic so the program depends less on manual Excel reporting.
Documenting process rules with business stakeholders, validating outputs and resolving data-quality issues to leave a maintainable reporting foundation.

roles.title: Technical Intern, Continuous Improvement
roles.headline: Fleet Forecaster: 6 h → 5 min, about $120K a year
roles.lead: I designed and built Fleet Forecaster and ran continuous-improvement projects across fleet operations.
highlights: Fleet Forecaster: a full-stack 10-year planning app for fleet replacement, demand and capacity, utilization, lifecycle, EV transition, cost and budget scenarios, in React and TypeScript, Python (Flask, moving to FastAPI), PostgreSQL, Redis, Excel/VBA and Power BI, for 10–15 planners and about 6,000 planning records.
Cut processing from about 6 hours to 5 minutes, planning effort by about 80% and reporting setup by about 40%, worth about $120K a year in savings.

Built Power BI dashboards and semantic-model logic for commuter-use and stipend operations, plus Power Apps, Dataverse and Power Automate workflows for intake, approvals, reminders and exception notices.

Prototyped AI Fleet Intelligence, an on-premises RAG and knowledge-graph assistant (vLLM, Ollama, pgvector, Neo4j) with an estimated $50K–$100K a year in avoided vendor cost, and fixed fleet-telemetry reporting logic.

roles.title: Business Intelligence / Data Engineer
roles.headline: $200K+ in client value
roles.lead: I led client-facing BI, analytics and data-engineering engagements across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product and Operations, worth $200K+ in client value.
highlights: Built ETL/ELT pipelines and analytics-ready models with Python, PySpark, Airflow, Kafka and dbt on Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks and PostgreSQL across AWS, Azure and GCP, with freshness checks, semantic metrics and data-quality controls.

Delivered Power BI, Tableau, Sigma and Looker reporting on operational performance, SaaS metrics, campaign ROI, profitability, churn and forecasts, integrating Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite and Google Analytics.

Applied regression, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting and causal analysis: about 30% better operational efficiency, 25% better forecast accuracy and 35% less reporting time.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Analyst / Data Engineer
roles.headline: 30% faster client onboarding
roles.lead: I owned client-facing BI and data delivery from discovery to go-live.
highlights: Ran requirements workshops and wrote BRD/FRD documentation, data-gap analyses and source-to-target mappings, then supported UAT/SIT, change control and training.
Built ETL/ELT and reporting workflows with Python, PySpark, Scala, Airflow, Dagster and Kafka over MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, ClickHouse and Trino.
Built Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Alteryx and D3.js dashboards on customer, churn, sales, SaaS and financial performance.
Cut client onboarding time by 30% with reusable playbooks and SOPs, improved data accessibility by about 40% and cut manual reporting by about 50%.

roles.title: Business Intelligence Intern
roles.headline: About 20% lower procurement cost
roles.lead: A business intelligence internship on procurement data.
highlights: Cleaned, analyzed and visualized procurement datasets with Python, Pandas, SQL and Excel, contributing to a reported 20% procurement-cost reduction.
Automated recurring reporting with Python scripts and Excel macros, saving more than 10 hours a week.

roles.title: Research Assistant & Principal Investigator
roles.headline: Principal Investigator on an IRB-approved study · MBA May 2026
roles.lead: Alongside my MBA in Business Analytics, I led applied research across AI, databases, autonomous agents and e-learning patterns.
highlights: Principal Investigator on an IRB-approved study of online patterns for course design: methodology, participant data, privacy controls and repeatable, versioned analysis.
Statistical work in Python, R, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, BigQuery and SAS: regression, hypothesis and A/B testing, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation and Bayesian analysis.
Built and evaluated RAG systems, agent workflows and LLM evaluation frameworks with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph and DSPy.
Presented to 50+ stakeholders and contributed to five publications, listed under Education & Research.

roles.lead: Security research, capture-the-flag leadership and systems building at NYU’s Center for Cybersecurity.

Built governed pipelines and tooling for security telemetry and research workflows in Python and SQL.
